test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The marked price of a perfume is Rs. 720. If the discount offered by a shopkeeper is 15%, then what is the selling price of the perfume?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**SP = (100 - 15)/100 × MP SP = 85/100 × 720 SP = **Rs. 612**
